method: Original directories retained locally; locked cache directories moved to backup early in an approved reboot. No original cache contents are included in this package.
validation_note: CUDA and NVIDIA DXCache inventories matched in existence and length. Four Windows D3DSCache WAL/SHM sidecar files from the pre-boot inventory were absent after shutdown/reboot; remaining main files matched in existence and length. File lengths are logical sizes, not allocated disk usage. No bytewise verification of all cache contents is claimed.
other_state_changes: NVIDIA service and overlay briefly restarted to release CUDA cache lock, then restored.
OS reboot accompanied the cache intervention.
interpretation: One bounded pass after combined cache reset and reboot; individual cache effects and reboot effects are not isolated.
